title: Collections Desk Scale: Lateness Multiplier on Equipment & Vehicle Loans Late Charges
content:
**Scale.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans late charge is multiplied by a lateness factor set by the days past due of the late installment on the booking date: 1.5 when they are 23 or more, 1.25 when they are 16 to 22, and 1.0 when they are 15 or fewer. The multiplication is made on the charge as figured from the percentage and the unpaid part, before any rounding; only the final product is rounded to cents, and the minimum and maximum late charge apply to that rounded figure.

## The scale

| Days past due on the booking date | Lateness factor |
|---|---|
| 23 or more | 1.5 |
| 16 to 22 | 1.25 |
| 15 or fewer | 1.0 |

## Both sides of each step

| Days past due | Factor |
|---|---|
| 15 | 1.0 |
| 16 | 1.25 |
| 22 | 1.25 |
| 23 | 1.5 |

## Hypothetical illustration

A charge figured at 80.00 from the percentage and the unpaid part, on an installment 24 days past due on the booking date, is multiplied by 1.5 to 120.00 before rounding; the product's minimum and maximum late charge then apply to the rounded figure.
